source.work: Giuseppe Pitrè, Feste patronali in Sicilia (1900)

method: Individually opened the OCR text layer of 200 previously no-observation original printed page locations; heuristic keywords returned 438 candidate sentence fragments requiring editorial reading, not 438 customs. Of 200 pages, 183 have substantial OCR body text and 17 have fewer than 100 extracted characters (often illustrations). The original source volume's scanned body only represents 548 of 560 numbered printed folios: 7–10, 23–26 and 151–154 are absent from both compressed and original scan binaries. Number-to-PDF offset corrected by 307 prior indexed source-folio pairs; no false PDF match for those 12 pages. No one is claiming all 200 pages were exhaustive editorially line-by-line audited or fully image-certified.
